criteria.requirement: Add evict(key)->bool and clear()->count to actual SingletonScope and ThreadLocalScope. Remove cached Providers under existing singleton lock, leave binding definitions and externally held objects untouched, perform no implicit close or dependency cascade. ThreadLocalScope operations affect only the calling thread, never another thread cache. Nonexistent keys and repeated clear are safe; subsequent actual Injector.get reconstructs only invalidated targets while unrelated singleton identity remains. For parent-shared instances document scope ownership and require calling the actual owning scope rather than promising child-local invalidation refreshes parent cache.
